Hi all — adding the compliance checklist and log export spec details here so Acme can start collecting assets. I’m pasting the short checklist and the plan below. I’ve also uploaded sample exports to the shared drive linked at the bottom.

Quick checklist (what we typically need for re-attestation):
- System architecture diagram (latest)
- User access reviews and PAM evidence for the last 12 months
- Application and auth logs (we ask for at least 12 months; rolling exports accepted)
- Incident response & root cause write-ups for any incidents in scope period
- Data retention policy excerpts and proof of enforcement

Log export spec (summary):
- Fields: timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type, resource, ip_address, request_id, result_code
- Format supported: ndjson or CSV; compressed archives accepted (.gz)
- Delivery: secure GCS bucket in EU region or encrypted SFTP
- Retention: Redwood can retain logs for the committed retention window (customer-configurable). For audit export we provide a time-bound export bundle.

Timing and responsibilities:
- By Oct 12: Acme to confirm scope and identify internal evidence owner (e.g., Jake Turner).
- Oct 13–20: Evidence collection window; Redwood will prepare a draft re-attestation letter and audit-ready bundle.
- Week of Nov 9: Finalize letter and incorporate any minor findings; targeted delivery Nov 12 so it’s available for your renewal on Nov 15.

I uploaded a sample export and the field mapping to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG_handoff-acme-soc2
HubSpot MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/R-2026-ACME-093

Attachment: log_export_spec.csv (sample mapping)

If Acme requires logs to be stored in EU-only GCP projects, we can ensure the export and archival retention are configured in the EU region. Tessa will coordinate the technical handoff for the log transfer.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
